335:t_1:86.en:
$n
「Then I'll be looking forward to the hero's big comeback.」

335:t_1:87.en:
$$桂$$
「Look at you, talking like that, $n. I'm glad to see you're growing up nicely.」

335:t_1:88.en:
$$桂$$
「Is this the result of your private lessons, Miss $$スズネ$$?」

335:t_1:89.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I'll leave that to your imagination.」

335:t_1:90.en:
$$桂$$
「It seems you've been growing as well.」

335:t_1:92.en:
$$桂$$
「My apologies. ...This is the comm code for Dr. $$トライア$$.」

335:t_1:93.en:
$$研究員$$
「Thank you. Now we can contact the doctor.」

335:t_1:94.en:
$$研究員$$
「Even in this lab, sending transmissions to the doctor from our side is restricted.」

335:t_1:95.en:
$$五飛$$
「Is the doctor's whereabouts hidden to that extent?」

335:t_1:96.en:
$$桂$$
「Yeah. Since the doctor broke the $$時の牢獄$$, the $$サイデリアル$$ crowd is after the doctor too.」

335:t_1:97.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Does the doctor have some reason for contacting us?」

335:t_1:98.en:
$$桂$$
「Apparently there's something the doctor wants to tell us. I don't know what it is either.」

335:t_1:99.en:
$$研究員$$
「The connection to the doctor is established. I'll put it on the main monitor.」

335:t_1:100.en:
$$トライア$$
「...Hello, hello, this is me calling the world. Please respond. Is the code connected properly?」

335:t_1:102.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Starting off with the 'hello, hello' routine again!?」

335:t_1:103.en:
$$トライア$$
「Well, don't mind it. It's more of a time-honored tradition.」

335:t_1:104.en:
$$トライア$$
「Anyway, I'm relieved. You all look well.」

335:t_1:105.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Though $c's strength is below 50% of what it was at the time of the $$時空震動$$ in $$第２新東京市$$.」

335:t_1:106.en:
$$トライア$$
「...That's just what I want to talk about. From here on, I want you to steel yourselves for the fighting ahead.」

335:t_1:108.en:
$$トライア$$
「It pains me a little to bring this up right after seeing your faces...」

335:t_1:109.en:
$$トライア$$
「According to the data we observed here, in response to the $$時空震動$$ in $$第２新東京市$$, an instantaneous warp of the dimensional boundary occurred at the galactic core.」

335:t_1:111.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「So those guys were sent to the galactic core.」

335:t_1:113.en:
$$桂$$
「You say that so casually, but at that distance even the $$マクロス・クォーター$$'s fold can't bring us back easily, you know.」

335:t_1:114.en:
$$トライア$$
「That's why I said you need to steel yourselves.」

335:t_1:115.en:
$n
「...So we have to fight the $$サイデリアル$$ on our own...」

335:t_1:118.en:
$$五飛$$
「Did you call us just to tell us that?」

335:t_1:119.en:
$$トライア$$
「That's not all. ...The next part is, relatively speaking, good news.」

335:t_1:120.en:
$$デュオ$$
「That's a relief. After a string of bad news, I couldn't have taken any more.」

335:t_1:122.en:
$$トライア$$
「Do you know the story that at the end of the $$時獄戦役$$, ancient ruins were found on 《$$リモネシア$$》?」

335:t_1:123.en:
$$マオ$$
「Now that you mention it, there was a story like that...」

335:t_1:124.en:
$$トライア$$
「It's been determined that they were built by the 《$$プロトカルチャー$$》.」

335:t_1:126.en:
$n
「Wait! Aren't the $$プロトカルチャー$$ the prehistoric civilization from $$アルト$$ and the others' world!?」

335:t_1:127.en:
$$スズネ$$
「If I remember correctly, they built a civilization in the distant past, used its power to create the warrior race $$ゼントラーディ$$, and made the ancestors of Earthlings intelligent.」

335:t_1:128.en:
$$トライア$$
「Thanks for the explanation, Miss $$スズネ$$. Put simply, it's just as you said.」

335:t_1:129.en:
$$トライア$$
「It seems those $$プロトカルチャー$$ came to $$リモネシア$$ in the $$ＡＤＷ$$ too. Across the wall between parallel worlds.」

335:t_1:130.en:
$$トライア$$
「I once heard from someone in the $$フロンティア船団$$ that $$リモネシア$$ is in the same position as an island connected to the $$プロトカルチャー$$ on their Earth, so I wondered if...」

335:t_1:131.en:
$$トライア$$
「Judging by the systems and language left behind, we can say it's almost certain those ruins were left by them.」

335:t_1:132.en:
$$トライア$$
「And those people left a useful message for us, who came long after.」

335:t_1:134.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「So that's what the doctor wants to tell us...」

335:t_1:135.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「What on earth is it...」

335:t_1:136.en:
$$トライア$$
「Straight to the point: it's about the mechanism of the collapse of the universe that comes once every 12,000 years.」

335:t_1:138.en:
$$トライア$$
「The end of the universe... Apparently it means erasing the power of life from the universe.」

335:t_1:140.en:
$$カトル$$
「That phrase... It's often said about $$バサラ$$, isn't it?」

335:t_1:141.en:
$$トライア$$
「Judging by the materials left in the ruins, it seems to be something far more universal.」

335:t_1:142.en:
$$トライア$$
「Apparently every living thing has it, and it's also the key that draws out the law of all things, that is, $$オリジン・ロー$$.」

335:t_1:145.en:
$n
「It's true that the $$スフィア$$s also draw out $$次元力$$ through human emotions and hearts, but...」

335:t_1:146.en:
$$スズネ$$
(I see... I'm starting to get the picture.)

335:t_1:148.en:
$$トライア$$
「According to the $$プロトカルチャー$$, once every 12,000 years, when the universe tries to be reborn...」

335:t_1:149.en:
$$トライア$$
「two energies collide: the force that seeks to vanish and the force that seeks to exist.」

335:t_1:150.en:
$$トライア$$
「To erase the force that seeks to exist, the force that seeks to vanish tries to erase the power of life, and...」

335:t_1:151.en:
$$トライア$$
「That's what gives birth to the $$バアル$$, apparently.」

335:t_1:152.en:
$$桂$$
「The universe gives birth to the $$バアル$$...」

335:t_1:153.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「So the end of the universe and the $$バアル$$ really were connected...」

335:t_1:154.en:
$$トライア$$
「And the ruins go on to say this...」

335:t_1:155.en:
$$トライア$$
「But life does not perish... Through blood of the beast, mingling of waters, destination of the wind, civilization of fire, and the sun's radiance, it walks the path of $$シンカ$$...」

335:t_1:156.en:
$$トライア$$
「Somehow, this '$$シンカ$$' seems to carry a different nuance from the 'evolution' we use.」

335:t_1:158.en:
$$トライア$$
「You seem to have an interest in this sort of thing, $n. ...As expected, it must be in the blood.」

335:t_1:160.en:
$$トライア$$
「Sorry, but I looked into a lot about you, now that you've become a Reactor.」

335:t_1:161.en:
$$トライア$$
「Your mother, Dr. $$メグミ・ラクナルド$$, published ambitious papers not only on super-dimensional physics but also on archaeology.」

335:t_1:164.en:
$n
「...I'm sorry, Doctor. I went to my father's place when I was six.」

335:t_1:165.en:
$$トライア$$
「...That's right. I'm sorry for bringing up needless things.」
